description: This file implements a command-line interface for managing a watchdog timer in Zephyr OS, including setup, disable, timeout configuration, and feeding the watchdog.

methods.name: parse_named_int
methods.description: Parses a string as an integer or looks it up in a list of string keys, returning the corresponding index or an error code.

methods.name: cmd_setup
methods.description: Sets up the watchdog device based on the device name argument.

methods.name: cmd_disable
methods.description: Disables the watchdog device based on the device name argument.

methods.name: cmd_timeout
methods.description: Configures a new timeout for the watchdog device, including reset mode and min/max timeout values.

methods.name: cmd_feed
methods.description: Feeds (kicks) the watchdog device on a specified channel.

methods.name: device_name_get
methods.description: Provides device name autocompletion for the shell command interface.
